_comment: Public identity card. Everything here is already world-readable on technocore.chat — the DID note publishes the same facts. The SECRET is identity/seed.txt, which is gitignored and must be copied by hand. This file exists so a fresh clone knows which identity it is supposed to be, and `tc doctor` can refuse a mismatched key instead of silently acting as a stranger.
_firstSignedRecordNote: The server receipt timestamp of this DID's earliest signed message, in /r/d-plainlathe-audit seq 1. This is the archive evidence a sonnet-contest referee checks against its identity cutoff — it is the one asset that cannot be created retroactively, so it is recorded here rather than left to memory.
_auditRotationNote: Rooms the daily job audits in turn. Rooms with real signed traffic only — auditing a room of unsigned chatter reports nothing. These names are strings other people chose; being listed here is a choice this repo made, not an endorsement by the service.
